events.title: Louis IX orders Jews in France to wear a badge
events.description: An ordinance of Louis IX required Jews to wear a coloured circle of cloth, the rouelle, on their clothing. It enforced a rule of the Fourth Lateran Council of 1215 and marked Jews out for discrimination.
events.html: An ordinance of Louis IX required Jews to wear a coloured circle of cloth, the rouelle, on their clothing. It enforced a rule of the Fourth Lateran Council of 1215 and marked Jews out for discrimination.

events.title: Union troops proclaim emancipation in Galveston, Texas
events.description: General Gordon Granger announced that all enslaved people in Texas were free, two and a half years after the Emancipation Proclamation. The day is celebrated as Juneteenth, a US federal holiday since 2021.
events.html: General Gordon Granger announced that all enslaved people in Texas were free, two and a half years after the Emancipation Proclamation. The day is celebrated as Juneteenth, a US federal holiday since 2021.

events.title: Emperor Maximilian of Mexico is executed
events.description: Maximilian, the Austrian archduke installed by France as Emperor of Mexico, was shot by firing squad at Querétaro with two of his generals. Benito Juárez's republic was restored.
events.html: Maximilian, the Austrian archduke installed by France as Emperor of Mexico, was shot by firing squad at Querétaro with two of his generals. Benito Juárez's republic was restored.

events.title: First Father's Day is held in Spokane
events.description: Sonora Smart Dodd organised the celebration to honour her father, a widower who raised six children. Father's Day became a permanent US national holiday in 1972.
events.html: Sonora Smart Dodd organised the celebration to honour her father, a widower who raised six children. Father's Day became a permanent US national holiday in 1972.

events.title: Julius and Ethel Rosenberg are executed
events.description: The couple were electrocuted at Sing Sing for passing atomic secrets to the Soviet Union. Ethel's role, in particular, remains disputed.
events.html: The couple were electrocuted at Sing Sing for passing atomic secrets to the Soviet Union. Ethel's role, in particular, remains disputed.

events.title: Kuwait gains independence from Britain
events.description: An exchange of notes ended the 1899 agreement that made Kuwait a British protectorate. Iraq claimed the new state, and invaded it in 1990.
